name: Gear Garage
summary: A motorbike and car accessories shop that draws each part onto your bike to check the fit before you buy
about: A dark, cinematic shop for motorbike and car accessories in Pakistan, in carbon black, safety orange and steel, priced in PKR. Pick your make, model and year once and every product shows a fit badge: the fit check draws the part onto a line drawing of your bike or car, and the helmet size guide turns a 3D helmet as you scroll. Compare up to three items, book workshop fitting in the cart, check out with cash on delivery, bank transfer or card, then track the rider and send warranty claims.
how: Open a page from the top bar: Shop, By vehicle, Helmets, Track order, Warranty, compare, your account or the cart
Choose your bike or car with the ride button or the finder on the home page, and every fit badge updates
On a part's page pick another vehicle and press Check fit to watch the part draw onto it
Scroll the helmet size guide to turn the helmet, drag it to spin, and type your head size to get a size
Tick Compare on up to three products, then add fitting in the cart and pick a workshop, day and time
Check out with cash on delivery, bank transfer or card, then follow the rider on the tracking page
Press Ctrl+K to search everything; reset demo data in Settings or the footer
